content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a personal to-do list","i_want":"to view all my saved tasks in a task list on the to-do management page","so_that":"I can see the status and priority of every task I have in one place","business_description":"The to-do management page shows the signed-in user's saved tasks as a list. Each row shows the task's status and priority. The list shows loading, empty and error states, and it refreshes after any task is created, updated, deleted or has its status changed. The backend provides the endpoints that return the task list and a single task by ID.","business_value":"Users can see their full task list and its status and priority at a glance, and they can tell whether the list is still loading, empty, or failed to load.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"I have two or more saved tasks","when":"I open the to-do management page","then":"the task list shows every one of my saved tasks"},{"given":"A task has the status Open and the priority High","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"that task's row shows a status indicator with the value Open and a priority indicator with the value High"},{"given":"The task list is waiting for the task data from the backend","when":"the page is displayed","then":"a loading state is shown in place of the task list until the data arrives"},{"given":"I have no saved tasks","when":"the task list loads successfully","then":"an empty state is shown and no task rows are displayed"},{"given":"The backend returns an error when the task list is requested","when":"the task list loads","then":"an error state is shown, no task rows are displayed, and the page does not show a successful state"},{"given":"The database is unavailable","when":"the backend receives a request for all tasks","then":"the backend returns an internal server error response and does not return any task data"},{"given":"A saved task with a known ID exists","when":"the backend receives a request for that task by its ID","then":"the backend returns that one task with its stored values"},{"given":"No saved task has the requested ID","when":"the backend receives a request for that task by its ID","then":"the backend returns a not-found error and does not return any task data"},{"given":"I am viewing the task list","when":"a task is created, updated, deleted or has its status changed","then":"the task list refreshes automatically and shows the change without a manual page reload"}],"edge_cases":["The user has no saved tasks: the empty state is shown instead of an empty table.","The backend returns an error or cannot be reached: the error state is shown and no task rows are displayed.","The database is unavailable:
